• **Beginning **(शुरुआत): The point in time or space at which something starts.

 
 
• **Example:** The beginning of the movie was really captivating.
 
 
 
• **Argument **(तर्क): An exchange of diverging or opposite views, typically a heated or angry one.
 
 
• **Example: **They had an argument about the best way to solve the problem.
 
 
 
• **Amateur** (शौकिया): A person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid basis.
 
 
• **Example:** He is an amateur photographer who loves capturing nature.
